audit_scope.description: Trust model for EIP-779 (DAO fork), Gray Glacier (difficulty bomb delay), EIP-1767 (GraphQL API), EIP-6051 (private key encapsulation), and EIP-7916 (SSZ progressive merkleization).
in_scope: DAO fork irregular state transition and balance recovery (EIP-779)
Gray Glacier difficulty bomb delay block validation (Gray Glacier)
GraphQL API query interface for EL data (EIP-1767)

misclassified_entities.reason: Block processing is an internal EL function (part of the block validation pipeline), not an external entity.
SSZ serialization is an internal client component used for encoding/decoding data structures.
The data source for SSZ merkleization is internal state data, not an external entity.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer (Miner)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Block producers submit blocks over unauthenticated P2P; blocks must be validated against DAO fork rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Token Holder
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Token holders are passive observers; their balances were modified by the DAO fork irregular state change.

trusted_external_entities.name: Miner
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miners submit blocks with difficulty values over unauthenticated P2P; difficulty must be validated against Gray Glacier formula.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Network
trusted_external_entities.rationale: The P2P network is unauthenticated; block propagation occurs without identity verification.

trusted_external_entities.name: GraphQL Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: GraphQL clients are unauthenticated external consumers querying EL state.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction submitters via GraphQL are unauthenticated; transactions require validation.

trusted_external_entities.name: API Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: API clients are unauthenticated consumers of the GraphQL interface.

trusted_external_entities.name: Sender Application
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Sender applications initiate key encapsulation; they are external and untrusted until authentication is established.

trusted_external_entities.name: Recipient Application
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Recipient applications receive encapsulated keys; trust depends on correct key management.

trusted_external_entities.name: Key Provider
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Key providers supply public keys for encapsulation; they are semi-trusted as they must provide authentic keys but operate over authenticated channels.

trusted_external_entities.name: Key Holder
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Key holders possess private keys; they are semi-trusted as they are authenticated by key possession.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Communication Channel
trusted_external_entities.rationale: The communication channel is explicitly untrusted; the encapsulation mechanism provides confidentiality over untrusted transport.

trusted_external_entities.name: Proof Consumer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Proof consumers receive and verify Merkle proofs; they are external unauthenticated verifiers.

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Blocks containing DAO fork state transitions
Blocks with difficulty values subject to Gray Glacier formula
GraphQL queries for block, transaction, and state data
Raw transaction data for pool submission
Public keys and encapsulated key material
Merkle proof requests and verification data

gaps: EIP-7916 SSZ merkleization had two misclassified internal components (serializer and data source).
